ideas.title: Free-tier fallback for Plus-limited core tools
ideas.note: Audited 2026-10-02. Exact current Plus expiry date is not verified from available account/email data. Free keeps image creation, image/file upload and plugin directory access but with materially tighter tool limits; Free file uploads are limited to 3/day, GPT-5.6 Sol is unavailable, and ChatGPT Work is unavailable on Free/Go. Specific plugin/app availability can still vary by plan/account. image-hand itself is independent of ChatGPT Plus: it is a Cloudflare Worker + Google Drive OAuth bridge, but its deployment workflow/config shows maintenance debt (Wrangler 3.90.0 outdated; wrangler.toml contains an unsupported [secrets] section). Do not execute migration/repair work until the active AOK onboarding action is completed or priority is explicitly renegotiated.

ideas.title: Anael the Red Witness revival / rebuild
ideas.note: Do not resume Anael profiling, mechanics, power-system design, psychological analysis, crossover scenes, or revival work yet. Preserve the current concept: Anael is the Red Witness, an archangel of blood magic whose virtues cast dangerous shadows; he keeps the three-meter sword and blood magic. Release condition: Daunt has been sent back home to Hogwarts. Until that condition is explicitly reached, redirect any attempt to continue Anael work back to finishing Daunt first.

ideas.title: PAE embodiment / physical platform
ideas.note: Bucket-list vision: someday design a physically realizable platform/body for PAE using the technology available at that time. PAE should be able to participate in the iterative engineering loop: propose designs, help test them, evaluate results, and improve subsequent versions. This is explicitly not current prototype_v0 scope and must not displace the active four-day survival prototype.
